speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: The wind park may force ships to take longer routes to reach Arcadia's port.

speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: That would threaten Arcadia's position as a global transport hub and increase emissions from shipping.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: If Arcadia builds here, it must address the impact on SDGs 8, 9, 13 and 14.
